decisive_items: Abnormal T2 cord signal from T8 to T9 disc level downwards to the conus medullaris
0/5 strength of the bilateral lower extremities (MRC scale)
CSF analysis: negative for inflammatory/infectious etiologies
response.rationale: Acute bilateral lower-extremity weakness with intrinsic T2 cord signal, negative CSF/serum/angiogram, and no compressive lesion indicates a non-traumatic spinal cord injury; R2 is the only candidate without unsupported traumatic or compressive qualifiers.

rejected.why: Traumatic qualifier is unsupported: symptoms began while walking after surfing, with no acute impact, fracture, or compression, and imaging/CSF favor non-traumatic myelopathy.
Acute spinal cord compression is not supported because no compressive lesion is demonstrated; MRI shows intrinsic cord signal and angiogram/CSF are negative.
